Does a Google Business Profile cost money?

Ava Digital · Updated 2026 · ~4 min read
Short answer: No. A Google Business Profile is 100% free to create, verify, and manage — Google never charges for it. If someone calls or emails demanding payment to “activate” or “verify” your listing, it’s a scam.

What’s free vs what you can pay for

Free: creating your profile, verifying it, posting updates, photos, hours, and responding to reviews. That’s everything that drives map-pack visibility.

Optional paid: running Google Ads (separate), or hiring an agency to optimize and manage the profile for you. Neither is required.

Watch out for the scam calls

Automated calls claiming your listing “will be removed” unless you pay are not from Google. Google does not cold-call for payment. Ignore them.

Why it matters

Your Google Business Profile is the single highest-ROI free asset a local business has — it’s often what decides whether you show up in the map pack at all. Fill it out completely and keep reviews coming.
